issues.title: Test multi-turn orders - including events
issues.body:
We wish to allow players to provide orders that span multiple turns.

Modify order generator to create a few orders that span multiple turns.

Generate suitable mock data to test order filtering methods.

Check that orders get correctly filtered when `Show orders for turn` drop-down is used.

Aah, this also affects get next interaction.  We only handle `start` and `end` if they occur during this turn.

When the start time for this order is before the current turn time, we don't generate an event. Same for if the end time is after the end of the turn.

But, if it generates a random time event, we should create an event for sometime in the current turn.

To allow random time events in multiple turns, we should include the turn number in the event id
